subject: Recap & pricing estimate — ACME inference (tokens, budget, invoice)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Recap & next steps — ACME inference pricing

Hi Alex — great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery and next steps so we stay aligned.

Key points I took away:
- Primary use case: contextual assistant inside ACME product (support + guided workflows).
- Expected monthly token volumes (ballpark you gave): 6–10M tokens/month in prod, 1–2M tokens/month in staging/dev.
- Latency SLO: P95 < 400ms for 95% of requests.
- Quality target: Redwood's base open-model profiles looked acceptable; you mentioned testing a smaller model footprint first.
- Budget range: you indicated a monthly budget range of $2k–$10k pending pricing/discounts.

What I need to confirm so I can produce a solid invoice estimate and cost model:
1) Finalized expected monthly tokens (prod + staging). If you prefer a conservative plan, we can model 8M prod + 1M dev.
2) Target $/1M tokens you need to hit (you mentioned ~$100/1M as a target on the call).
3) Any compliance or data residency constraints that would change hosting (gov/private).

I'll prepare a short invoice estimate and attach a cost model spreadsheet showing unit economics (per-1M tokens) across Hosted vs Dedicated with commit levels. Expect that from me by end of week.

Next steps:
- You: confirm the monthly token estimate and target $/1M (reply to this thread).
- Me: send a 1-sheet invoice estimate + cost model and recommended plan (Hosted vs Dedicated) with a suggested commit to meet your budget.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | (415) 555-0134

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>

Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — ACME inference pricing

Thanks Sean — good summary. A few clarifications from our side:

- Tokens: current expectation after ramp is roughly 8M tokens/month in production (user queries + assistant responses), plus ~1M tokens for staging and experiments. Peak burst could be ~1.5x for short periods.
- Quality: we want to start with a cost-conscious open model and then evaluate larger models for high-value flows.
- Budget: finance gave a soft range of $3k–$8k/month; they'd like to see per-1M token unit economics to compare against internal thresholds (~$75–$120 per 1M tokens target).
- Contracting: procurement@acme.com is looped in for any SOW/PO steps.

Please include: line items for model pricing (small/medium/large), hosting type (Hosted vs Dedicated reserved), any setup fees, and estimated monthly total at 8M tokens.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Monica and I will review your estimate.

Cheers,
Alex

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-25T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: ACME — Pricing & invoice estimate (8M tokens/month)
Attachments: ACME-Redwood-Estimate-20260925.xlsx, redwood-cost-model-1Mtokens.csv

Alex / procurement team — attaching the estimate and the cost-model CSV as discussed. High-level summary inline:

Assumptions used in the model:
- Baseline: 8,000,000 tokens/month (prod) + 1,000,000 tokens/month (staging) = 9,000,000 tokens total for monthly estimate.
- Model mix: start with Redwood-open-small for 85% of calls (cost-efficient), Redwood-open-medium for 15% of calls (higher-quality flows).
- No Dedicated reserved commit in initial model (we show both Hosted pricing and a 12-month Dedicated commit scenario).

Hosted (pay-as-you-go) estimate — monthly:
- Redwood-open-small: $25 per 1M tokens (inference) => 7.65M tokens * $25 = $191.25 (note: values scaled to per-1M units in sheet)
- Redwood-open-medium: $75 per 1M tokens => 1.35M tokens * $75 = $101.25
- Platform & network + minimal request overhead: ~$1,000/month (est)
- Estimated monthly total (Hosted): ~$1,300 (this is illustrative; see spreadsheet for line-level math).

Dedicated (12-month commit) estimate — monthly average:
- Committed unit price at 50M tokens/month equivalent: $60 per 1M tokens blended => for 9M tokens = $540/month
- Dedicated includes reserved capacity SLA and reduced egress/cross-region costs.
- Setup/one-time ramp fee (optional): $4,000 (professional services + provisioning) — shown as separate line in the attached invoice.

Target unit economics: to hit ~$75–$120 per 1M tokens, Hosted pricing maps well for very low usage proof-of-concept. For predictable production at 8–9M tokens/month, Dedicated with a modest commit (12-month) gets you into the $60–$80/1M blended range which fits your $3k–$8k budget easily depending on commitment level and model mix.

Attachments:
- ACME-Redwood-Estimate-20260925.xlsx: one-page invoice-style estimate with Hosted vs Dedicated comparisons and monthly totals at multiple commit levels.
- redwood-cost-model-1Mtokens.csv: token-level unit economics and sensitivity table (per-1M price by commit).

Next steps:
1) Review the attached estimate and confirm which scenario you want modeled (pure Hosted, 12-mo Dedicated, or hybrid).
2) If Dedicated, we can provision a reserved pool and share a draft SOW/PO template.
3) I'll follow up with a formal invoice and (if needed) a DocuSign link for signature.

If you'd like, I can also produce a 3-scenario deck (Conservative / Target / Aggressive) showing monthly cost ranges and break-even points for Dedicated commit.

Thanks — attaching files and flagging for Monica/Neha to help coordinate procurement.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | (415) 555-0134
